title: glycosmis longipes
intro: Glycosmis longipes, commonly known as the Wild Quinine, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Glycosmis longipes include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and exhibit antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
